title: Der erste Streit
desc: Nobody raises their voice, which is worse
setting: A kitchen on a Thursday, two cups, and a Saturday you did not mention.

options.feedback: The true answer and it costs you. Anything else here would be a second mistake on top of the first.
Vague where she was exact. Arguments here run on specifics, and blurring one is read as hiding it.
You did not. She is about to say so, and the difference between forgetting and not saying is the whole argument.
Schade is a very big word here. Explaining over the top of it is the second mistake.
Three minutes of explaining. She let you do it once and it did not help either of you.
Agreeing with the size of it. That is more than an apology and it takes four words.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Du hast es nicht vergessen. Du hast es nicht gesagt.
steps.en: You did not forget. You did not say it.

options.feedback: She is right. Forgetting is an accident and not saying is a small decision, and she named it exactly.

options.es: So habe ich das nicht gemeint.
options.en: I did not mean it that way.
options.feedback: The sentence for a misunderstanding, and this is not one. She will say doch.
It is not, and you know it is not. This is the point of the whole conversation.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.en: I have to go to the hospital.

options.feedback: Fair, and it hands her the next move. Nothing was arranged and now nothing is.
A day. Leaving an argument with no date is the thing that makes two days feel like a month.
It is true that she is using it as a way out. It is also a night shift, and it starts at seven.
